passages.title: Sports Event Recount
passages.text: On Saturday afternoon, the school futsal team played a friendly match against a neighbouring school. The visitors scored in the first half. During the break, the captain reminded everyone to pass carefully instead of rushing. In the second half, Lani equalised with a shot from outside the area. The match ended 1–1. Afterward, both teams thanked the volunteers who had prepared the court. The captain wrote that good teamwork had mattered more than winning the friendly match.
